global: This shio ramen features a clear, light broth with neatly arranged toppings: dark nori, tender chashu, and crisp menma. Served in a white bowl with red geometric trim, it rests on a wooden table under soft, warm lighting.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, smooth grain patterns, and subtle natural texture under soft lighting.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with red geometric patterned rim, smooth surface, circular shape, slightly raised edge.
regions.soup: The broth with noodles shows golden-yellow liquid, thin noodles, green onions, and dark seaweed, all resting in a shallow, round bowl.
regions.seaweed: Nori seaweed pieces show dark green, textured, irregular shapes with visible surface ridges and slight yellowish edges.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice appears pale pinkish-brown, slightly translucent, with irregular edges and faint marbling visible on its surface.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, slightly translucent, with a fibrous texture and curved, segmented shape.
